---
title: "Native Shiny cell editing test cases"
output: html_document
---

Run the chunk below in an interactive R session after loading the development package with `devtools::load_all()`.
Alternatively, run `source("@travail/app.R"); runEditingDemo()` from the repository root.

```{r app, eval=FALSE, purl=TRUE}
library(shiny)
library(reactable)

makeEditingApp <- function(virtual = FALSE, module = FALSE) {
  cars <- MASS::Cars93[1:12, c("Manufacturer", "Model", "Type", "Price")]
  cars$id <- paste0("car", seq_len(nrow(cars)))
  cars$Manufacturer <- as.character(cars$Manufacturer)
  cars$Model <- as.character(cars$Model)
  cars$Type <- as.character(cars$Type)
  cars$Available <- TRUE
  cars$CheckedOn <- as.Date("2026-01-01")
  cars$Notes <- ""
  columns <- list(
    id = colDef(show = FALSE),
    Model = colDef(tooltip = function(value) paste("Modele en lecture seule :", value),
                   headerTooltip = "Colonne non editable avec tooltip"),
    Manufacturer = colDef(editable = TRUE, editor = "text",
                          headerTooltip = reactableTooltip(tags$b("Constructeur du vehicule")),
                          tooltip = function(value) paste("Constructeur initial :", value),
                          editStatus = "text", editStatusDuration = 5000),
    Type = colDef(editable = TRUE, editor = "select",
                  editorOptions = list(choices = unique(cars$Type))),
    Price = colDef(editable = TRUE, editor = "number",
                   tooltip = reactableTooltip(tagList(tags$b("Prix"), tags$br(), "Valeur positive, en milliers.")),
                   editorOptions = list(step = 0.01)),
    Available = colDef(editable = TRUE, editor = "checkbox", editStatus = "none", inputDisabled = TRUE,
                       tooltip = "Champ desactive ; aide accessible au clavier sur son conteneur."),
    CheckedOn = colDef(editable = TRUE, editor = "date"),
    Notes = colDef(editable = TRUE, editor = "textarea", editValidation = FALSE,
                   editorOptions = list(rows = 2))
  )
  tbl <- reactable(
    cars, rowId = "id", columns = columns, selection = "multiple",
    rowActions = list(add = TRUE, remove = TRUE, removeDisabled = "car1"),
    tooltips = list(cells = list(car1 = list(Price = "Prix de la premiere voiture"))),
    disabledInputs = list(rows = "car2",
      cells = list(car1 = list(Available = FALSE), car2 = list(Manufacturer = FALSE), car3 = "Notes")),
    filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, pagination = !virtual, defaultPageSize = 4,
    virtual = virtual, height = if (virtual) 320 else NULL,
    language = reactableLang(
      editLabel = "Modifier {name}, ligne {rowId}",
      editPending = "Enregistrement...",
      editSaved = "Enregistre",
      editUnavailable = "Edition disponible uniquement dans Shiny",
      rowAdd = "Ajouter une ligne",
      rowRemoveLabel = "Supprimer la ligne {rowId}",
      rowRemoveConfirm = "Supprimer la ligne {rowId} ?",
      rowAddPending = "Preparation de la nouvelle ligne...",
      rowAdded = "Ligne ajoutee", rowRemoved = "Ligne supprimee",
      rowAddedLabel = "Lignes ajoutees"
    )
  )

  ns <- if (module) NS("demo") else identity
  ui <- fluidPage(
    titlePanel("Edition native Shiny"),
    p("Prix positif, constructeur non vide. Les autres modifications sont acceptees."),
    p("Ajouter : ligne complete fournie par R, epinglee en bas jusqu'a integration.",
      "Supprimer : confirmation puis notification serveur. car1 est protegee."),
    checkboxInput(ns("custom_ids"), "ID personnalise pour le prix des nouvelles lignes", FALSE),
    actionButton(ns("integrate_rows"), "Integrer les ajouts au tri et aux filtres"),
    div(
      actionButton(ns("tooltip_rules"), "Tooltip par cellule et en-tete"),
      actionButton(ns("tooltip_input"), "Tooltip du premier prix par ID"),
      actionButton(ns("tooltip_clear"), "Effacer les regles de tooltip")
    ),
    p("Prix : tick 2 secondes. Constructeur : statut texte 5 secondes. Case : sans indicateur.",
      "Notes : application locale, sans validation serveur ni tick ; sauvegarde dans l'observateur."),
    actionButton(ns("native_update"), "updateNumericInput : premier prix = 25"),
    actionButton(ns("native_options"), "updateTextInput : modifier le placeholder"),
    div(
      actionButton(ns("disable_row"), "Desactiver ligne car1"),
      actionButton(ns("disable_column"), "Desactiver colonne Price"),
      actionButton(ns("clear_disabled"), "Effacer regles et exceptions"),
      actionButton(ns("disable_cell"), "Desactiver premier prix par ID"),
      actionButton(ns("enable_cell"), "Reactiver premier prix par ID"),
      actionButton(ns("combined_input"), "Prix = 35 et disabled dans un message"),
      if (requireNamespace("shinyjs", quietly = TRUE)) tagList(
        shinyjs::useShinyjs(),
        actionButton(ns("shinyjs_disable"), "shinyjs : desactiver premier prix"),
        actionButton(ns("shinyjs_enable"), "shinyjs : reactiver premier prix")
      )
    ),
    reactableOutput(ns("cars")),
    h4("Derniere modification"),
    verbatimTextOutput(ns("last_edit")),
    h4("Derniere action de ligne"),
    verbatimTextOutput(ns("last_action")),
    h4("Observation individuelle de input$cars_car1_Price"),
    verbatimTextOutput(ns("individual")),
    h4("Donnees confirmees cote serveur"),
    tableOutput(ns("saved"))
  )
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    saved <- reactiveVal(cars)
    lastEdit <- reactiveVal(NULL)
    lastAction <- reactiveVal(NULL)
    nextKey <- 12L
    individual <- reactiveVal(NULL)
    output$cars <- renderReactable(tbl)
    output$saved <- renderTable(saved())
    output$last_edit <- renderPrint(lastEdit())
    output$last_action <- renderPrint(lastAction())
    output$individual <- renderPrint(individual())

    observeEvent(input$cars_car1_Price, {
      individual(input$cars_car1_Price)
    }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

    observeEvent(getReactableRowAction("cars"), {
      action <- getReactableRowAction("cars")
      lastAction(action)
      current <- saved()
      if (identical(action$action, "add")) {
        nextKey <<- nextKey + 1L
        row <- cars[1, , drop = FALSE]
        row$id <- paste0("car", nextKey)
        row$Manufacturer <- "Nouveau"
        row$Model <- "Nouveau modele"
        row$Price <- 0
        row$Available <- FALSE
        row$Notes <- ""
        ids <- if (isTRUE(input$custom_ids)) c(Price = paste0("new_price_", row$id)) else NULL
        # A production application must check permissions and persist before replying.
        saved(rbind(current, row))
        addReactableRow("cars", row, inputIds = ids, requestId = action$requestId)
      } else if (identical(action$action, "remove")) {
        index <- match(action$rowId, current$id)
        if (is.na(index) || identical(action$rowId, "car1")) {
          showNotification("Suppression non autorisee ; donnees restaurees", type = "error")
          updateReactable("cars", data = current)
          return()
        }
        saved(current[-index, , drop = FALSE])
      }
    }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

    observeEvent(input$integrate_rows, {
      updateReactable("cars", data = saved())
    })

    observeEvent(input$tooltip_rules, {
      updateReactable("cars", tooltips = list(
        rows = list(car2 = "Aide commune a car2"),
        cells = list(car1 = list(Price = reactableTooltip(
          tags$span(tags$b("Prix car1"), " : aide mise a jour"), placement = "right"
        ))),
        headers = list(Price = "Le serveur accepte les prix positifs")
      ))
    })
    observeEvent(input$tooltip_input, {
      updateReactableTooltip(session, "cars_car1_Price",
        reactableTooltip(tags$em("Aide prioritaire par ID"), placement = "bottom"))
    })
    observeEvent(input$tooltip_clear, {
      updateReactable("cars", tooltips = list())
    })

    observeEvent(getReactableEdit("cars"), {
      edit <- getReactableEdit("cars")
      lastEdit(edit)
      current <- saved()
      index <- match(edit$rowId, current$id)
      editable <- setdiff(names(current), "id")
      if (is.na(index) || !edit$columnId %in% editable) {
        resolveReactableEdit("cars", edit, error = "Cellule non autorisee")
        return()
      }
      value <- edit$value
      valid <- switch(edit$columnId,
        Manufacturer = is.character(value) && length(value) == 1 && nzchar(trimws(value)),
        Type = is.character(value) && length(value) == 1 && value %in% unique(cars$Type),
        Price = is.numeric(value) && length(value) == 1 && is.finite(value) && value >= 0,
        Available = is.logical(value) && length(value) == 1 && !is.na(value),
        CheckedOn = is.null(value) || (is.character(value) && length(value) == 1 &&
          grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", value) && !is.na(as.Date(value))),
        Notes = is.character(value) && length(value) == 1
      )
      if (!isTRUE(valid)) {
        resolveReactableEdit("cars", edit, error = "Valeur refusee par le serveur")
        return()
      }
      old <- current[[edit$columnId]][index]
      oldJSON <- if (is.na(old)) NULL else if (inherits(old, "Date")) as.character(old) else unname(old)
      if (!isTRUE(all.equal(oldJSON, edit$oldValue, check.attributes = FALSE, tolerance = 0))) {
        resolveReactableEdit("cars", edit, error = "La valeur a change sur le serveur ; recharger les donnees")
        return()
      }
      if (edit$columnId == "Manufacturer") value <- trimws(value)
      if (edit$columnId == "Price") value <- round(value, 2)
      current[[edit$columnId]][index] <- if (edit$columnId == "CheckedOn") {
        if (is.null(value)) as.Date(NA) else as.Date(value)
      } else {
        value
      }
      saved(current)
      if (edit$columnId != "Notes") resolveReactableEdit("cars", edit, value = value)
    }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

    observeEvent(input$native_update, {
      # This targets a mounted widget: keep the first row visible for this test.
      current <- saved()
      current$Price[1] <- 25
      saved(current)
      updateNumericInput(session, "cars_car1_Price", value = 25)
    })
    observeEvent(input$native_options, {
      updateTextInput(session, "cars_car1_Manufacturer", placeholder = "Constructeur")
    })
    observeEvent(input$disable_row, {
      updateReactable("cars", disabledInputs = list(rows = "car1"))
    })
    observeEvent(input$disable_column, {
      updateReactable("cars", disabledInputs = list(columns = "Price"))
    })
    observeEvent(input$clear_disabled, {
      updateReactable("cars", disabledInputs = list())
    })
    observeEvent(input$disable_cell, {
      updateReactableInput(session, "cars_car1_Price", disabled = TRUE)
    })
    observeEvent(input$enable_cell, {
      updateReactableInput(session, "cars_car1_Price", disabled = FALSE)
    })
    observeEvent(input$combined_input, {
      current <- saved()
      current$Price[1] <- 35
      saved(current)
      session$sendInputMessage("cars_car1_Price", list(value = 35, disabled = TRUE))
    })
    if (requireNamespace("shinyjs", quietly = TRUE)) {
      observeEvent(input$shinyjs_disable, {
        shinyjs::disable("cars_car1_Price")
      })
      observeEvent(input$shinyjs_enable, {
        shinyjs::enable("cars_car1_Price")
      })
    }
  }
  appServer <- if (module) {
    function(input, output, session) moduleServer("demo", server)
  } else {
    server
  }
  shinyApp(ui, appServer)
}

makeEditingApp()
```

## Manual checks

- Hover/focus a header and an input. Escape closes help first; a second Escape cancels an editor draft.
- Focus the container around a disabled Available input. Its help must remain keyboard accessible.
- Update by cell/header rules, then by input ID. Page/scroll away and back; ID override persists.
- Clear rules: column defaults return. Check validation errors keep their own accessible descriptions.
- With a tooltip open, scroll/resize near viewport edges; it remains readable and hoverable.
- Repeat in module and virtual mode; deleted/unmounted cells must not leave orphan tooltip portals.
- Add twice, with default IDs then the custom price ID. Check server data and the action event.
- Filter/search to exclude the new values, sort, group, or change pages: additions remain at the bottom.
- Integrate additions: rows now participate in sorting, filtering, grouping and pagination.
- Cancel removal: nothing changes. Confirm: server data and remaining selection/expansion stay consistent.
- Repeat with an empty table and `makeEditingApp(virtual = TRUE, module = TRUE)`.
- In virtual mode, scroll away and back; appended inputs remain reachable, without duplicate binding IDs.

1. Change each of the six editor types. Check individual inputs, global edit payload and confirmed server data.
2. Type without leaving a field: no edit should be sent. Blur or press Enter to submit.
3. Use Enter in Notes to insert a newline, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to submit, and Escape to cancel.
4. Enter a negative price: the server rejects it and an accessible error remains beside the draft.
5. Enter a constructor surrounded by spaces: the server returns the trimmed value to the same native input.
6. Edit after sorting or filtering: the stable `carN` key must identify the original record.
7. Leave drafts on one page, navigate away and return. Confirmed data must not be overwritten by a draft.
8. Use the two native updater buttons while the first row is visible. No global user-edit event should be created.
9. Run `makeEditingApp(virtual = TRUE)` and repeat after scrolling away and back. Test pagination in the default mode.
10. Check keyboard focus, screen-reader labels, pending announcements and error descriptions.
11. Render the table inside a Shiny module and verify namespaced input IDs and acknowledgments.
12. Configure an ID override, then configure a duplicate override: the latter must fail explicitly.
13. Price: check neutral pending state, then a green tick for 2 seconds after acceptance.
    Start typing before expiry: no previous tick or error should remain, even for an invalid draft.
14. Manufacturer uses text status for 5 seconds; Available hides indicators but retains accessible announcements.
15. Notes applies locally without a pending state or validation tick.
    Its server observer still receives and saves edits.
16. Set `editStatusDuration = 0`, then accept an edit: success remains until new input.
    Scroll or paginate away and back after a timed success expires: it must not reappear.
17. Initially, Available is disabled except car1; car2 is disabled except Manufacturer; car3 Notes is disabled.
18. Disable a row or column, then enable its Price cell by ID: the explicit cell exception must win.
    Reset table rules: per-ID exceptions clear, while Available's column default remains disabled.
19. Type a draft, then disable through a table rule or external DOM command: confirmed data returns without an edit.
    Disable while an edit is pending: acceptance or rejection must not enable the input.
20. Send a combined value/disabled message, then a native value update: the disabled input still accepts server values.
21. When shinyjs is installed, disable/enable by ID and scroll away/back: the explicit override must survive.
    Without shinyjs, test the same external DOM change with the browser's disabled property.
